business.title: Work with 3DPIY
business.intro: Need a commercial license for an existing design, or a brand-new design made just for you? Here's how that works.
business.licensingBody: Most 3DPIY designs are sold under a personal-use license. A commercial license lets you use a design in a business context — for example selling printed items made from it. Licensing is available per design; get in touch to check availability and pricing.
business.commissionsBody: Have an idea for a product, accessory or organizational solution that doesn't exist yet? 3DPIY takes on a limited number of custom design commissions, from a single bespoke part to a full product line.
business.legalNotice: Licensing terms are finalized on a per-project basis and will be reviewed before 3DPIY launches commercially.
business.dollsComingSoonTitle: Business for Dolls & Mini is on its way
business.dollsComingSoonBody: Want to sell your own printed doll furniture or miniatures? A commercial license for the Dolls collection is in the works — feel free to reach out if you're already interested.

aboutPage.title: Print It Yourself
aboutPage.introBody: 3DPIY started from a simple idea: if you own a 3D printer, you shouldn't have to settle for generic files. Every design here is modeled from scratch, test-printed, and refined before it's released — practical objects you'll actually use, not just things that look good in a render.
aboutPage.makerBody: 3DPIY is a one-person studio. I design, test-print and document every file myself before it goes live — from a quick IKEA fix to a full dollhouse miniature. I care about things that actually work on your printer, with clear instructions and no guesswork.
values: Designed and tested in-house — nothing published without a real test print
Clear, honest documentation — materials, settings and limitations, no surprises
Independent and small on purpose — direct contact, no faceless support queue
